description: Audit a Node.js project's npm dependencies for license compliance before commercial release. The project is commercial software that requires permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC). You must create a file named 'LICENSE_AUDIT_REPORT.md' in the project root directory (/home/ga/workspace/license_audit_project/) that documents: (1) A summary of total dependencies and any license issues found, (2) A detailed list of dependencies with their licenses and risk levels (high/medium/low), (3) Identification of any GPL, AGPL, or other copyleft licenses that are incompatible with commercial distribution, (4) Any dependencies with missing or unclear license information, (5) Recommended alternatives for problematic dependencies. The report should be in markdown format with clear sections and tables or lists. Pay special attention to finding any GPL-licensed packages as they pose the highest risk for commercial software.
